names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 18 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Roman diaconul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Ρωμανός», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 18 ноября ст. ст., «Роман Кесарийский, Антиохийский, диакон, сщмч.», with the grade and rank words left off. Both sees are kept because the calendar prints both and its life page explains them: a deacon of Caesarea in Palestine who moved to Antioch. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 18. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Роман и Варул.“ — «Св.» is “saint”, «муч.» is the `martyr` grade, and the name beside his is the other member of the pair; his deaconry and his see are both in the body, so the bare forename is the whole of the form. It joins a fold of six, declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit; the string was already five wide and unread.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 ноября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Романа диакона и отрока Варула (303).»
doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 18 noiembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Roman diaconul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ρωμανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives him «(; - 304)» and the body states the year of his death, so a `death` is proposed, the folder carrying no `dates`. The entry: he lived at the beginning of the fourth century; because Asklepiades, the eparch of Antioch, was shouting and blaspheming against Jesus Christ, Romanos's faithful heart took fire, and he waited for the moment the eparch was entering the temple of the idols and told him to his face that the idols are not gods; the angry ruler had his tongue cut out, God by a miracle kept his speech without it, he preached Christ to his jailers, and the idolaters, unable to bear the wonders, drowned him in 304. **The day's open question, and it is saint.gr's own.** The same day carries a second entry, `/3038/` «Άγιος Ρωμανός από την Παλαιστίνη (; - 298)», deacon of the Church at Caesarea in Palestine, martyred at Antioch under Diocletian, tongue cut out, miraculously speaking, strangled in prison — and that page closes «Διαπιστώνουμε εδώ, ότι το μαρτύριο του Αγίου αυτού συγχέεται με αυτό του προηγουμένου, κατά την ήμερα αυτή, Αγίου Ρωμανού και πολύ πιθανόν να πρόκειται για το ίδιο πρόσωπο» — very probably the same person. **That second page is asterisked and carries «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου», so it is refused**, and the row here is read from the unasterisked entry. This folder's own epithet, the Deacon of Caesarea, comes from the tradition the *refused* page describes and not from the page quoted here, which gives him no rank at all; the writer may want to look at both. The Ἀπολυτίκιον names him with Plato and is copied onto both. The Κοντάκιον names him and is taken **exactly as the page prints it**, including its closing words, which repeat the end of the apolytikion and read as the site's own transcription error — `docs/CORPUS.md` §3's rule is that a reading which looks wrong is the source's and not the scrape's. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.12.2025 (18. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Роман и Варул.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, an enumerated pair, and both folders exist. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book strangles him in prison in 303, which is one side of the «303 or 304» this folder already holds from two calendars a year apart, and a third book choosing between the two does not close the interval. No `related` row added: the child is already related both ways, and the governor Asclepiades is not a saint of this corpus. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: that he was a deacon of the church of Caesarea preaching zealously at Antioch, the words spoken in the governor's path to the heathen temple — you sin, governor, the idols are not gods, Christ alone is the true God — the beating and the raking without mercy, and that it was ROMANUS who pointed the child out to the governor, saying that this little child is more sensible than you in your age, for it knows the true God and you do not. The Serbian form „Роман“ widens a fold to six and the key is written in the same commit.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Platon; al Sfântul Mucenic Roman diaconul», glas 4, a common of martyrs printed once for the two of them; the page's «nesctricăciunii» is its own reading and is copied as it stands

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength they overthrew the tormentors, and broke the powerless presumption of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Δυὰς ἡ εὐκλεής, τῶν κλεινῶν Ἀθλοφόρων, ἐδόξασε λαμπρῶς, τὴν Ἁγίαν Τριάδα, ὁ Πλάτων ὁ ἔνδοξος, Ρωμανὸς τε ὁ ἔνθεος, ἐναθλήσαντες, καὶ τὸν ἐχθρὸν καθελόντες, ὅθεν πάντοτε, ὑπὲρ ἠμῶν δυσωπούσι, τὸν μόνον Φιλάνθρωπον.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’. Χορὸς Ἀγγελικός — printed on both men's pages for 18 Νοεμβρίου, and it names them both, so it is copied onto both folders.

english.text: The glorious pair of the renowned prize-winners — Plato the illustrious and Romanos filled with God — gloriously glorified the Holy Trinity by their contest, and pulled the enemy down; and so they entreat for ever on our behalf the only Lover of mankind.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἀστέρα μέγιστον, ἡ Ἐκκλησία, Ῥωμανὲ πανεύφημε, σὲ κεκτημένη ἀληθῶς, φωταγωγεῖται τοῖς ἄθλοις σου, τὴν φωτοφόρον δοξάζουσα μνὴμην σου. τὸν ἐχθρὸν καθελόντες, ὅθεν πάντοτε, ὑπὲρ ἠμῶν δυσωπούσι, τὸν μόνον Φιλάνθρωπον.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Άγιος Ρωμανός», and it names him. Copied whole, as the page prints it: its last three clauses repeat the ending of the apolytikion above it on the same page and do not belong to this kontakion's sense, and that is the source's reading and not the scrape's.

english.text: Possessing you truly as a very great star, all-praised Romanos, the Church is lit by your contests and glorifies your light-bearing memory. — having pulled the enemy down, and so they entreat for ever on our behalf the only Lover of mankind.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников Платона и Романа»

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from thee our God; for having thy strength they cast down the tormentors and shattered the feeble insolence of the demons also. By their prayers save our souls.

death.note: Two sources one year apart and the interval is widened to hold both. saint.gr gave the 304 this folder held flat; days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 18 ноября ст. ст. with «(303)» and its life page closes his own death «(+ 303)». Neither page gives a year of birth.
